title: Most Adults Cannot Pass This Doctor's Entrance Exam
summary: Ten questions test anatomy, symptoms, diagnostic tools and safe clinical reasoning.

landing.intro: The anatomy questions seem familiar. Then the test moves into symptoms, emergencies and clinical decisions.

about.body:
This ten-question entertainment challenge uses broad medical concepts that are taught and understood across Tier 1 English-speaking countries. It moves from anatomy and physiology into diagnostic tools, symptom patterns, emergency priorities and responsible medicine use.

Choose one answer for each question. Correctness stays hidden until the final reveal, where the complete answer review is available to unlock.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Answer ten increasingly difficult clinical knowledge questions.
Reveal your score, then unlock every answer you missed.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This is not a medical-school admission exam, professional qualification, diagnosis or medical advice. Seek qualified medical care for personal symptoms or emergencies.

profile-5.title: The First-Round Applicant

doctor-q1.question: Which chamber of the heart pumps oxygen-rich blood into the aorta?

doctor-q2.question: Sudden facial drooping, arm weakness and speech difficulty should raise immediate concern for what?

doctor-q3.question: Which device provides a rapid, non-invasive estimate of blood oxygen saturation?

doctor-q4.question: In a classic presentation of appendicitis, abdominal pain may move toward which area?

doctor-q5.question: Which cells in the pancreas produce insulin?

doctor-q6.question: What does auscultation mean during a physical examination?
answers: Examining a tissue sample under a microscope

doctor-q7.question: Which description best matches sepsis?
answers: A condition caused only by allergies
A life-threatening extreme response to infection

doctor-q8.question: What is the functional filtering unit of the kidney called?

doctor-q9.question: A person is unresponsive and not breathing normally. What is the safest immediate general response?
answers: Call emergency services and begin appropriate basic life support
Wait several minutes for spontaneous recovery
Ask the person to walk around

doctor-q10.question: Which statement about antibiotics is most accurate?
answers: They do not treat viral infections such as the common cold
They should always be stopped as soon as symptoms improve
They work by lowering body temperature directly
